texts.li: {X_nameDef} stopped {A_nameDef} on the way to breakfast to say {X_pronoun} hadn't slept that well since leaving home. {A_nameDef} said it was only a bed, and looked pleased all morning.
{X_nameDef} wanted to know who had built the guest room, and ran a hand along the bedframe while {A_nameDef} told {X_objective}.
Most places {X_nameDef} stays put their guests in a barn, {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef} over supper. {A_nameDef} passed that on to everyone who'd helped build the room.
[winter] {X_nameDef} said the guest room was the first warm night {X_pronoun} had had since the snow came, and thanked {A_nameDef} twice.
[x:royal] {X_nameDef} inspected the guest room with the air of someone used to better, then admitted to {A_nameDef} that it would do very nicely.
[x:nobed] {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef}, politely, where guests were meant to sleep. {A_nameDef} didn't have a good answer.
[x:nobed] {X_nameDef} spent the night curled up against a wall and told {A_nameDef} in the morning that {X_pronoun} had slept in worse ditches, but not many.
[x:roompoor] The guest room was clean enough, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, and then mentioned the draft, the bare floor and the smell from the pens.
[x:roompoor] {A_nameDef} overheard {X_nameDef} telling another guest that the bed here cost the price of a good one and gave the comfort of a sack.
[x:roompoor] {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} whether the colony had ever had a guest before, in a voice that suggested {X_pronoun} doubted it.
{A_nameDef} walked {X_nameDef} around the colony and ended at the spot by the wall where the first shelter stood. {X_nameDef} asked good questions all the way round.
{A_nameDef} showed {X_nameDef} the workshops and the pens, and {X_nameDef} told {A_objective} how {FACTION} does the same work back home.
{X_nameDef} wanted to see everything, the latrine included. {A_nameDef} answered questions until the light went.
[skill:Plants] {A_nameDef} showed {X_nameDef} the fields, and they argued happily about seed until the supper bell.
[skill:Animals] {A_nameDef} introduced {X_nameDef} to every animal in the pens by name. {X_nameDef} kept up for a while.
[rain] {A_nameDef} took {X_nameDef} round the colony under a shared cloak, ducking from one doorway to the next.
Over supper, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about home, and mostly about a brother who has owed {X_objective} money for six years.
{X_nameDef} described the place {FACTION} calls home so well that {A_nameDef} could almost see the smoke over the roofs.
{A_nameDef} asked {X_nameDef} what {FACTION} eats at a wedding, and got the whole wedding, from the first quarrel to the last song.
[theirLowtech] Among {FACTION}, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, the elders choose the planting day by the moon and the first frog.
[theirHightech] {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about the town {X_pronoun} grew up in, with streets lit all night and a market that never closed.
[x:faction:Empire] {X_nameDef} explained to {A_nameDef} how the Empire's titles pass from one holder to the next, and which of them are worth having. It took most of the evening.
[x:old] When {X_nameDef} was a child, {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef}, there was a winter the lake froze so hard they drove carts across it.
{X_nameDef} couldn't sleep in a strange bed, and found {A_nameDef} still up. They talked until the fire was down to embers.
{A_nameDef} came across {X_nameDef} sitting outside in the dark, homesick. {A_nameDef} sat down too, and neither of them went in for a long while.
{X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} shared the last of the tea and the rest of the night, talking about the people they'd left behind.
[clear] {A_nameDef} showed {X_nameDef} which stars the colony steers by. {X_nameDef} knew them by different names.
[storm] Neither {X_nameDef} nor {A_nameDef} could sleep through the thunder, so they sat in the kitchen and counted the seconds between the flashes and the bangs.
{X_nameDef} wouldn't hear of being waited on, and spent the afternoon fetching and carrying for {A_nameDef} like one of the colony's own.
[work:Cooking] {X_nameDef} wandered into the kitchen and started peeling. {A_nameDef} let {X_objective}; there were a lot of potatoes.
[work:Growing] {X_nameDef} took off {X_possessive} coat and worked a row beside {A_nameDef}, then refused to take any of the harvest for it.
[work:Hauling] {X_nameDef} saw {A_nameDef} struggling with a load and took the other end without being asked.
[work:Construction] {X_nameDef} held the boards while {A_nameDef} nailed them, and had opinions about the nails.
{X_nameDef} wanted a coat from the colony's stall at half the price on it. {A_nameDef} talked {X_objective} up to three-quarters, and they both went away pleased.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} haggled over a pair of boots for a quarter of an hour, entirely for the fun of it.
{X_nameDef} tried to pay {A_nameDef} with a story instead of silver. It was a good story; {A_nameDef} still took the silver.
{X_nameDef} pressed a small carved bird into {A_nameDef}'s hand, a thank-you for the stay. {A_nameDef} put it on the shelf above {A_possessive} bed.
"Best stop on the whole road," {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}. {FACTION} would hear about it, {X_pronoun} promised.
{X_nameDef} left {A_nameDef} a pouch of seeds from home and the advice to plant them somewhere sunny.
[x:royal] {X_nameDef} thanked {A_nameDef} formally for the colony's hospitality, then less formally, with a bottle {X_pronoun} had been saving.
